components.name: Solid Button

components.css: .ds-plate { position:relative; display:block; width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; padding:0; border:1px solid rgba(244,241,234,0.12); border-radius:0; background:#0a0c15; color:#f4f1ea; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; overflow:hidden; } .ds-plate-media { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2a2434 0%,#0d0f18 55%,#1b1526 100%); filter:saturate(0.86) contrast(1.03); transition:transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), filter 400ms ease; } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate-media, .ds-plate:focus-visible .ds-plate-media { transform:scale(1.035); filter:saturate(1) contrast(1.03); } .ds-plate-no { position:absolute; top:8px; left:10px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0.18em; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.72); text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-plate-caption { position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0 0; display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:10px 10px 9px; background:rgba(5,6,12,0.86); border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); transform:translateY(100%); transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate-caption, .ds-plate:focus-visible .ds-plate-caption { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-plate-name { min-width:0; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:12px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.92); } .ds-plate-view { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0.18em; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.62); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b7a2ff; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The user center is an owner's archive, not a settings dashboard. It is lit like a print room after hours: near-black paper (#05060c), warm ink (#f4f1ea), one violet (#b7a2ff) for index numbers, selection and focus, and the user's own photographs as the main source of color on the page. There is no glass, no gradient headline and no shadowed card. Structure comes from hairlines, tonal paper steps, a ruled ledger and a numbered index rail whose marker travels between five records.

Type does the editorial work. The owner's name is set at billboard scale in Noto Serif SC; record titles, the member pass and measurement numerals stay serif; the interface speaks in Noto Sans SC; catalog metadata, dates, counts, IDs and states are JetBrains Mono. A staggered six-plate contact sheet prints recent uploads beside the masthead, each plate an unrounded frame whose caption slides in on hover or keyboard focus.

Light and dark are the same layout under two lights: paper (#faf7ff), ink (#1e1b4b), violet (#7c3aed), with the same rhythm and rules. All photography is user content; the capture set under .impeccable/review uses picsum placeholders and is not a shipping asset. The older global Fredoka/Nunito tokens and glass helpers in design-tokens*.css belong to surfaces outside this system.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black archive paper with warm ink; a warm-lilac paper and indigo ink in the light theme.
Noto Serif SC at billboard scale for the name, headings and measurements.
JetBrains Mono for catalog metadata, measurements, dates and state tokens.
Hairline rules and tonal paper steps instead of cards, shadows or glass.
User photographs supply the imagery and the dominant color; chrome stays paper, ink and violet.
A 01-05 index rail with a traveling 2px marker, beside a staggered contact sheet.

rules.name: The Photographs Carry the Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays inside paper, ink and violet. Outside that violet, saturation enters only through the user's uploaded images; no decorative gradients, neon glows or gradient text belong to the archive.

rules.name: The Two Lightings Rule
rules.body: Dark and light are one layout under two lights. Only the page-local color variables swap; type, spacing, shape and motion do not fork by theme.

rules.name: The One Deep-Violet Object Rule
rules.body: The active member pass is the only filled gradient surface. It is the single deliberate exception to flat paper, and it never leaves the violet family.

rules.name: The Serif Names Rule
rules.body: Names, record titles, the pass and measurement numerals are set in Noto Serif SC. Never set UI chrome, labels or long prose in the serif.

rules.name: The Ledger Mono Rule
rules.body: Any measurement, date, archive ID, count, unit or state token is JetBrains Mono, and numbers use tabular figures. Mono is catalog data, not decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No box-shadows, glass panels or blurred card backdrops. Separate surfaces with a hairline or a tonal paper step; reserve blur for the single static atmosphere layer.

rules.name: The Nearly-Square Rule
rules.body: Controls get 2px, media and panels get 0, pills get 999px. There are no rounded cards in the archive.

dos: Do keep the shell at 1360px with clamp(20px, 5vw, 64px) gutters and a single centered column.
Do set the owner's name in Noto Serif SC 600 at clamp(52px, 8vw, 116px) with 0.98 line-height.
Do build structure from 1px rules and the Archive Paper to Raised Paper tonal step.
Do render uploaded images at saturate(0.86) contrast(1.03) and release to full saturation on hover or focus.
Do set measurements, dates, counts, units and IDs in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do keep both themes on one layout and swap only the page-local color variables.
Do use 2px radius on controls, 0 on media, and 999px only for chips and the switch.
Do show a 2px Archive Violet focus-visible outline at 3px offset on every interactive element.
Do keep primary controls at 42px desktop and 44px at 860px and below.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, glass panels, backdrop blur or neon glows to the archive; the atmosphere layer is the only blur.
Don't use gradient text or a second accent hue.
Don't fill empty plates or empty states with stock imagery; use the hatch, the serif mark and one action.
Don't use icons in place of photographs.
Don't round media frames, cards or the member pass.
Don't set names, record titles or measurements in the sans or the mono.
Don't use the mono for prose or standalone decoration; it carries catalog metadata only.
Don't introduce a third theme or per-section palettes.
